contracts.name: profile-scribe.source-record
contracts.description: Normalized crawl result for a user-supplied URL.

contracts.name: profile-scribe.voice-profile
contracts.description: Compact style profile derived from previous posts.

contracts.name: profile-scribe.post-draft
contracts.description: Fresh draft ready for Profile Scribe review or submission.

contracts.name: profile-scribe.submission-receipt
contracts.description: Receipt returned by Profile Scribe after staging or publishing.

contracts.name: profile-scribe.opportunity-tournament-job
contracts.description: Research-only worker input for selecting one evidence-grounded professional opportunity.

fields.name: payload.budget.maxLLMCalls
fields.description: At most two calls: generator plus mandatory critic on a successful v5 path, or generator plus one bounded full-response repair with no accepted winner.

contracts.name: profile-scribe.opportunity-tournament-result
contracts.description: Compact incremental-income tournament receipt stored by the ProfileScribe worker; it authorizes no outreach, enrichment, publishing, or provider write.

fields.name: metadata.nextExperiment
fields.description: One review-first business evidence experiment or one cause-matched technical recovery when no winner is defensible.

fields.name: metadata.nextExperiment.knownFact
fields.description: Business experiments only: the approved known fact or explicit evidence gap grounding the experiment; absent from strategy-generation recoveries.

fields.name: metadata.nextExperiment.buyer
fields.description: Business experiments only: the named buyer or buyer fact to ground; absent from strategy-generation recoveries.

fields.name: metadata.nextExperiment.paidOffer
fields.description: Business experiments only: the current paid offer or paid-offer fact to ground; absent from strategy-generation recoveries.

fields.name: metadata.nextExperiment.acquisitionMechanism
fields.description: Business experiments only: one singular discovery or permissioned acquisition path; absent from strategy-generation recoveries.

fields.name: metadata.nextExperiment.conversionDestination
fields.description: Business experiments only: the conversion destination kept distinct from acquisition; absent from strategy-generation recoveries.

fields.name: metadata.nextExperiment.paidConversion
fields.description: Business experiments only: the observable paid conversion; absent from strategy-generation recoveries.

fields.name: metadata.nextExperiment.attributionSignal
fields.description: Business experiments only: the durable record field connecting acquisition to payment; absent from strategy-generation recoveries.

fields.name: metadata.searchSpace.commercialCritic.inputFinalists
fields.description: Ordered bounded bindings of exact finalistId/familyId pairs supplied to an attempted critic.

fields.name: metadata.searchSpace.providerPreflight
fields.description: Zero-call credential preflight receipt when provider authorization is blocked before dispatch.
